title: Class Participation Rates
content: After implementing weekly discussion prompts and peer review sessions, class participation rates increased by 15% over the past month.

title: Meeting with Emily Thompson
content: Emily confided that her father's recent diagnosis has been a significant stressor, impacting her ability to focus in class and participate.

title: Engagement Techniques
content: Techniques that have proven effective: 1) Starting each class with a thought-provoking question, 2) Using real-world examples to illustrate theoretical concepts, 3) Encouraging students to lead parts of the discussion.
